mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we have clear skies with a temperature of 37 degrees near the Verona Public Library. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Verona Municipal Court reminds residents that they can pay most traffic citations online, though those with O W I tickets must schedule an appointment. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to review new development projects.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run today, and tomorrow brings the Dane County Farmers Market along with live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can catch the John Denver music tribute this Saturday.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake, a local favorite. Culver's of Verona is open until 10:30 PM today, so stop by soon to grab a scoop before they close for the evening.
